result.instructions: Tools for Twenty, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Twenty data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run twenty_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run twenty_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run twenty_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. twenty_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: twenty_list_metadata_objects
tools.title: List metadata objects
tools.description: List all objects (standard + custom) and their fields from the Twenty schema — use this to discover custom objects/fields and valid field names. Twenty REST: GET /rest/metadata/objects.

tools.name: twenty_list_people
tools.title: List people
tools.description: List/filter people (contacts). Supports cursor pagination, raw filter/order_by, and relation depth. Twenty REST: GET /rest/people.

limit.description: Results per page (1-60, default 20 — Twenty caps at 60).

starting_after.description: Pagination cursor — return records after this cursor (from a previous page's pageInfo).

ending_before.description: Pagination cursor — return records before this cursor (from a previous page's pageInfo).

filter.description: Raw Twenty filter string, passed verbatim as ?filter=. Syntax: field[comparator]:value, e.g. `employees[gte]:100` or `stage[eq]:"MEETING"`. Comparators: eq, neq, gt, gte, lt, lte, in, is, like, ilike, startsWith.

order_by.description: Raw Twenty ordering string, passed verbatim as ?order_by=, e.g. `createdAt[DescNullsLast]`.

depth.description: How deep to hydrate related records: 0, 1, or 2.

tools.name: twenty_get_person
tools.title: Get person
tools.description: Get a single person (contact) by id. Twenty REST: GET /rest/people/{id}.

depth.description: How deep to hydrate related records: 0, 1, or 2.

tools.name: twenty_create_person
tools.title: Create person
tools.description: Create a new person (contact). All fields optional; firstName/lastName combine into name:{firstName,lastName}. Twenty REST: POST /rest/people.

companyId.description: Id of the company to link this person to.

extra.description: Passthrough object of additional/custom fields merged into the request body verbatim.

tools.name: twenty_update_person
tools.title: Update person
tools.description: Update fields on an existing person. Only provided fields change. Twenty REST: PATCH /rest/people/{id}.

companyId.description: Id of the company to link this person to.

extra.description: Passthrough object of additional/custom fields merged into the request body verbatim.

tools.description: Create a new company. `name` is required. Twenty REST: POST /rest/companies.

domainName.description: Primary domain / website URL (sent as domainName:{primaryLinkUrl}).

idealCustomerProfile.description: Whether this company matches the ideal customer profile.

tools.name: twenty_create_opportunity
tools.title: Create opportunity
tools.description: Create a new opportunity (deal). `name` is required; amountMicros combines with currencyCode into amount:{amountMicros,currencyCode}. Twenty REST: POST /rest/opportunities.

amountMicros.description: Opportunity amount in micros (× 1,000,000). Sent as amount:{amountMicros,currencyCode}.

currencyCode.description: Currency code for the amount (default USD; only sent when amountMicros is provided).

stage.description: Pipeline stage — e.g. SCREENING, MEETING, PROPOSAL, NEGOTIATION, CUSTOMER (custom pipelines vary).

extra.description: Passthrough object of additional/custom fields merged into the request body verbatim.
